# Evaluation

How well Budgie's extraction works on real receipts, and whether the review status catches the wrong extractions. The method and the scoring rules are in [decision 0028](wiki/decisions/0028-evaluation-truth-and-scoring.md) and the [evaluation page](wiki/backend/evaluation.md).

| `qwen2.5vl:3b/v3` | 100 % (100 %) | 94 % | 89 % | 94 % | 89 % / 91 % / 90 % | 85 % | 2/2 (model 2, rule 0) | 0/18 | 1/2 | 0 in 0 | 0 in 0 | 54.7 / 118.6 | 373 | 0 |

Valid (no repair): the share of answers that passed the schema, and in brackets those that needed no repair turn. For a model `not_a_receipt` the extractor doesn't say whether a repair happened, so it counts as valid without repair. Missing: case runs without a matching cache entry, including infrastructure errors (`llm_*`, `interrupted`), which are never cached.

Invented examples: an item equal to a prompt example (name and amount) that has no similar line on the receipt; the model added it. Example amount on a real item: an item equal to a prompt example whose name matches a real line with another amount. That can be a correct reading when the receipt prints the same price (e.g. the per-bottle Pfand 0.25), so each one needs a look at the photo.
